description: Weltweit: Flughäfen is a dataset listed in Open Data im Rhein-Kreis Neuss, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by openflights.org. Dieser Datensatz enthält alle auf openflights.org registrierte Flughäfen mit IATA-Code und weiteren Informationen. Coverage: Rhein-Kreis Neuss. The portal files it under International themes, Traffic. Its keywords are flughäfen. The portal shows 7,847 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-04-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) (http://dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/odbl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-rhein-kreis-neuss-de-portal.
